title: The command surface on cobra + fang: styled help, errors, version, completions and man pages
description:
OPERATOR, 2026-09-23: fang (github.com/charmbracelet/fang) for the CLI. ticfac's commands are hand-rolled on flag.NewFlagSet (eleven of them in internal/cli). Move the command tree to cobra - the framework tk already uses, so the two tools behave alike - and wrap it with fang.Execute: styled help and usage, styled errors without the repeated usage dump, --version from build info, a completion command and man pages.

Keep every existing command, flag, exit code and output contract byte-for-byte where a test or a script depends on it (exit codes are asserted: ExitNoExecutor and friends). Fang is marked experimental; pin it and keep the wrapper thin enough to drop.

This is the foundation 89m (ticfac watch) and the skills/MCP work stand on: one command tree that the help, the completions, the generated skill and an MCP surface (ophis) can all be derived from.
acceptance_criteria: Every ticfac command runs on cobra wrapped by fang with styled help and errors, --version, completions and man pages; every existing exit code and scripted output is unchanged, proven by the existing tests; and fang is pinned
